view_note: Four serial projects (694 MW) sit ahead of the South of Phoenix cluster, all at Saguaro or Milligan. Only two system upgrades came out of the serial process, both 69 kV: the $5.5M Eastgate–Vista rebuild shared by Q256 (68%) and Q264 (32%), and Q295's $6.7M Santa Rosa–Asarco Tap reconductor. Q239 at Saguaro 230 kV needed only a breaker position.
full_note: The serial block adds only $12.2M of 69 kV upgrades around Milligan. The South of Phoenix cluster's large 230/500 kV upgrades are triggered by Transition and later cluster MW on top of the 694 MW of serial capacity.
